provider: Hugging Face Storage Buckets via S3 gateway (s3.hf.co) — as an annex/DVC backend

free_tier.stated: Public repos/buckets: 'Best-effort' — no published numeric ceiling on a Free account (private is a hard 100 GB). Storage plans table: Free user or org = Public 'Best-effort', Private 100 GB. HF is on the known list, but the S3 gateway is new and turns HF into a generic S3 endpoint, which is the part that matters for this slot.

egress.terms: Free and CDN-backed: 'Egress and CDN included at no extra cost'. Served via CloudFront, so downloads are cacheable. This is the single best egress term of any LFS-adjacent host found.

tooling: Any S3 client: AWS CLI, boto3, s5cmd; `hf` CLI (`hf sync`, `hf buckets`); python `huggingface_hub`. For this slot: `git annex initremote type=S3 host=s3.hf.co region=us-east-1 requeststyle=path` (annex needs path-style, which the gateway requires anyway) and `dvc remote add ... ; dvc remote modify myremote endpointurl https://s3.hf.co/<namespace>`. S3 creds are derived from an HF token via 'Generate S3 credentials' (HFAK... key).
chaining: Bucket-per-purpose, unlimited buckets per namespace, unlimited free orgs. Because buckets are NON-versioned, git-annex supplies the versioning (hash-keyed objects) and DVC supplies the pointer layer — that combination gives you a versioned 500GB+ dataset store on a free, CDN-backed S3 endpoint. Dedupe is chunk-level on the Xet backend, so re-pushing near-identical files is cheap.
limits_note: Bucket = not Git, so no git LFS semantics — you get S3 PUT/GET only. Hard limit: 'no single file will exceed 500GB' for Hub repos (buckets: gateway multipart, docs recommend 2 GB multipart chunks). Recommended <100k files and <10k entries per folder; >200 GB files discouraged due to CloudFront not caching them. Region pinned us-east-1. Gateway does not parse aws-chunked trailing checksums — must set request_checksum_calculation=when_required.

identity_cost.detail: inferred from the category 'academic'; the source record states no identity cost, so this is a class assumption, not evidence

reliability_note: Free public storage is explicitly 'best-effort' and HF says 'Beyond the first few gigabytes, please use this resource responsibly', with a mitigation the page describes as 'in place to prevent abuse', meaning a limit on excess use. That is the softest possible enforcement language, but also the least contractual. Gateway is single-region (us-east-1).
